name: craft-workflow-evolution
description: Compatibility helper that turns evidence-backed execution observations into bounded Workflow drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Create bounded Workflow drafts for Craft Quality to evaluate.
interface.longDescription: This compatibility helper ingests only sanitized execution observations and creates a bounded Workflow draft. It does not form a standalone evolution loop: use complete Craft with Craft Quality for evaluation, signoff, canary, and rollback.
defaultPrompt: Create a bounded Workflow draft from these sanitized execution observations; do not publish it before independent evaluation.
